annotations.title: exists_reduction — Proved Constructively
annotations.body: The key insight: the statement only needs det-value witnesses, not geometric sub-triangles. Given |det(T)| = n > 1, we take T1 = unit triangle (det=1) and T2 = elongated triangle with vertices (0,0),(n-1,0),(0,1) having det=n-1. This removes the previous axiom.

annotations.title: exists_primitive_triangulation — Strong Induction
annotations.body: For any n ≥ 1 and lattice triangle T with |det(T)| = n, produces a list of exactly n primitive triangles. Proved by Nat.strongRecOn: base n=1 returns [T] (T is primitive), inductive step applies exists_reduction then IH to each piece.

annotations.title: edge_split_det_add — Determinant Additivity
annotations.body: When g divides both components of the edge v1→v2, inserting the midpoint M = v1 + (v2-v1)/g splits T into splitLeft and splitRight, and their determinants sum to det(T). Proved by extracting the divisibility witnesses and closing by ring.
